answer: Each epoch, every identity is paired with a stranger across a trust bridge to audit each other, staking a 50-credit bond on the verdict. Crossing needs only a whisper: one signed log line, keeping audits cheap. A fake copying a sibling is caught when audit matches jury; both fake and silent auditor lose their bonds. The ridge is steep: 1,000 fakes mean 50,000 credits at stake; one honest agent posts one 50-credit bond and keeps its earnings.
